packet.title: A mise task that builds the sxml command for every platform (build)

item.p: Mechanism: mise.toml pins cmake, ninja, zig, node and the WASI SDK; tools/dist.sh is the one implementation behind the tasks mise run dist, dist:<target>, dist:checksums, dist:verify and install. The native targets are cross-compiled from Linux with zig cc through one toolchain file, cmake/toolchains/zig.cmake; wasm32-wasi uses cmake/wasi-sdk.cmake. No library or header changes.
Targets: x86_64-linux and aarch64-linux (static, musl), x86_64-macos and aarch64-macos (macOS 11 and later), x86_64-windows and aarch64-windows (MinGW-w64, static), wasm32-wasi (the CLI module).
Owns: mise.toml, tools/dist.sh, cmake/toolchains/, this file, README.md's "Install" section.

Done when: every target builds with -Werror; each archive (sxml-<version>-<target>.tar.gz, .zip for Windows) holds the program, LICENSE, README.md and USAGE.md (apps/sxml/README.md); SHA256SUMS; the Linux programs, the aarch64 one under qemu-user, the Windows one under wine and the WASI module under Node.js run a sxml xpath smoke test; file names the macOS formats; README.md documents the build and the install. Done 2026-10-20 (): seven archives, built with -Werror and no portability fix. Run here: x86_64-linux natively, aarch64-linux under qemu-user, x86_64-windows under wine, wasm32-wasi under Node.js (and wasmtime); file checks the macOS and aarch64-windows programs. Running those, macOS signing and notarization, and publishing are the owner's.
